title: Crystallized Broom
text: Place an Analysis Crystal in the regular Arcane Assembly Table's center. The six outer slots take a hay bale, two sticks, two Spiritual Crystals and one Resonance Crystal in any order. The analysis crystal becomes part of the broom.

Place and right-click to mount. Forward/back moves, left/right steers, Space lifts and Shift dismounts at any time. Movement and lift start at 1 block per second and accelerate to 2 after holding for about a second. Releasing or reversing resets acceleration. Releasing lift lets gravity pull it down; it cannot hover or accept upgrades.
Collisions do not break it. Underwater it remains rideable but sinks steadily and cannot lift. It supplies neither air nor protection. Attack an unoccupied broom to collect it.
